SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-06-2026 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO SEP-02-2026 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF OSCAR PINEDA IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT COSTILLA IS PRESENT. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $1962.00 TO THE PLAINTIFF IN $400 MONTHLY PAYMENTS. THE FIRST PAYMENT TO BE MADE ON MAR-20-2026 AND SUBSEQUENT PAYMENTS ARE TO BE MADE ON THE 20TH OF EACH MONTH AFTERWARDS. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE SEP-02-2026 HEARING IF DEFENDANT FAILS PAY THE SETTLEMENT AMOUNT, AND A JUDGEMENT WILL BE RENDERED AT THAT TIME. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PER SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CARRIE ZEPEDA; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506) P
